timestamp_convention: refund_date is UTC event date; sale attribution resolved from referenced line
schema_evolution: Unknown additive fields retained; incompatible types/missing fields quarantined; unsupported schema versions rejected

refund_id.description: Stable synthetic refund event ID; distinct partial refunds have distinct IDs

line_id.description: Original order line; multiple refunds may refer to one line

refund_date.description: UTC refund event date; may follow sale by days

amount_cents.description: Merchandise refund; cumulative amount cannot exceed discounted line total

version.description: Monotonically increasing correction version per refund_id
